description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe standing in profile at her plate glass window in her Abiquiu studio. She wears a white collared long sleeved  jacket over a white collared shirt with a round silver hand-hammered dome button / pin at the neck, and a broomstick-type skirt with arms at sides. Visible on the windowsill are tubes of paint, a collection of paint brushes, a large steer horn, and two blank canvases. O'Keeffe's face and most of the room is  in shadow with illumination from the window.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe
